title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Claim File Figures Used in a Settlement
content:
When a settlement under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` is worked out, the figures describing the loss come from one particular claim file on the cover. This page identifies that file and the figures taken from it.

## Which file

The claim being approved is the cover's claim file that stands at documents complete. A cover never carries more than one file in that state.

## Figures taken from that file

- the **claim amount**, in US dollars;
- the **affected packages**, the number of packages lost or damaged;
- the **affected weight**, the gross weight in kilograms of the goods lost or damaged.

## Kind of loss

Because a cover has only one claim open at a time, the file at documents complete is also the most recent notice lodged on the cover. The kind of loss for the settlement is the kind of loss stated on that most recent notice.

## Input, judgement, output

| What the cover's claim files show (hypothetical) | Judgement | Figures used |
|---|---|---|
| one file at documents complete: 8100.00 USD, 30 packages, 612.5 kg, wet damage; two earlier files already decided | the documents-complete file is the claim approved | 8100.00 USD, 30 packages, 612.5 kg; wet damage |
| one file at documents complete, lodged most recently, stating shortage | the kind of loss follows the most recent notice | shortage |
